terms.label: Unrestricted Cash Amount

evidence.quote: provided, that the Unrestricted Cash Amount shall not be deemed to be greater than (A) for the first 24 months following the Closing Date, the greater of (i) the excess of the Unrestricted Cash Amount (calculated without regard to this proviso) over $20 million and (ii) 100% of Adjusted Consolidated EBITDA for the most recently ended Test Period as of such time and (B) thereafter, 100% of Adjusted Consolidated EBITDA for the most recently ended Test Period as of such time.

terms.note: For the first 24 months after closing the cap was the greater of (cash minus $20M) and 100% of Adjusted Consolidated EBITDA; 100% thereafter. Not checked whether later amendments changed this definition.

amendments_considered.what_changed: Incremental Assumption Agreement and Amendment No. 1 (2023-02-14): delayed draw term loan. Section 6.09 text unchanged.

Amendment No. 2 (2023-06-30): Covenant Relief Period with Total Net Leverage table 5.00 (6/30/23), 5.25 (9/30/23), 5.50 (12/31/23-9/30/24), 5.00 (12/31/24), 4.50 (3/31/25). ICR minimum changed 1.50 -> 2.00 (struck/inserted in blackline; confirmed by the Q2 2023 10-Q).

Amendment No. 3 (2024-02-15): covenant switched from Total Net Leverage Ratio to Secured Net Leverage Ratio. Relief table raised: 6.00 (3/31/24), 6.25 (6/30/24, 9/30/24), 6.00 (12/31/24, 3/31/25); added rows 5.50 (6/30/25), 5.00 (9/30/25), 4.75 (12/31/25), 4.50 (3/31/26). ICR 1.50 through 9/30/25, 2.00 from 12/31/25. Added $15,000,000 monthly Minimum Liquidity covenant.

Incremental Assumption Agreement and Amendment No. 4 (2025-01-15): relief rows changed 6/30/25 5.50->6.00, 9/30/25 5.00->5.50, 12/31/25 4.75->5.25. Minimum Liquidity limited to the Covenant Relief Period. Incremental revolver.

Amendment No. 5 (2025-11-04): relief rows 12/31/25 5.25->5.50, 3/31/26 4.50->5.25, added 6/30/26 5.00, 9/30/26 4.50, 12/31/26 4.00. ICR 1.50 through 12/31/25, 1.75 from 1/1/26 to 9/30/26, 2.00 from 10/1/26. Read from the Amendment No. 6 conformed copy plus A5 plain text; A5 markup did not render as redline.
Amendment No. 6 (2026-06-30): Section 6.09 levels unchanged (only 'latest' maturity-date wording). Used as the clean conformed source for the final table.
Not an amendment: new Credit Agreement dated 2026-10-21 (Rabobank agent), likely refinancing this facility. Not labeled. So the 2026-12-31+ thresholds may never have been tested.

draft_notes: Thresholds are the levels in force at each test date, taking each amendment's table as of its signing (A3 Feb-2024, A4 Jan-2025 and A5 Nov-2025 each changed only current or future quarters). Superseded schedules are described in amendments_considered.

The Total Net Leverage covenant is labeled through 2023-12-31 and the Secured Net Leverage covenant from 2024-03-31 because Amendment No. 3 (2024-02-15) renamed the test. A3's table relabels the 2023 rows as Secured Net Leverage. Dat should decide whether the 12/31/2023 test was under Total or Secured.
Secured Net Leverage numerator is secured Consolidated Debt less the Unrestricted Cash Amount; numerator_label records 'Consolidated Debt'.

Covenant Relief Period ends at the earlier of 2026-10-01 or an early termination election. After that the standard Secured Net Leverage covenant is 4.00 (the original first-six-quarters 4.50 has lapsed); the 2026-12-31 table row is also 4.00. An optional Step-Up Election (4.50 for 4 quarters after a Permitted Acquisition) is not listed.
The 4.50 original level nominally covered the 'first through sixth full fiscal quarters' after the 2022-08-29 closing. effective_to 2023-03-31 reflects the A2 relief table taking over at 2023-06-30.
ICR 2.00 for 6/30/23-12/31/23 comes from Amendment No. 2's blackline ('1.502.00' in plain text) and the Q2 2023 10-Q sentence quoted as evidence.

Minimum Liquidity first test date = last Business Day of the first full calendar month after the A3 effective date (2024-02-15) = March 2024. Recorded as 2024-03-29 (Good Friday; verify the Business Day definition). The last test is assumed 2026-09-30 because the Covenant Relief Period ends 2026-10-01.
Anti-Cash Hoarding (6.09(d), mandatory prepayment if Unrestricted Cash > $20M) is not a maintenance ratio and is not labeled.

Adjusted Consolidated EBITDA children follow the ORIGINAL 2022 definition. Later amendments add a time-varying cap on clause (xii) (70% -> 20% of Adjusted Consolidated EBITDA for periods ending 2025-04-01 through 2026-10-01+, in the A6 conformed copy). Not modeled.
